title: 第10章 日记
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰推开大门。

    锈蚀的合页发出一声刺耳的尖响。

    他侧身闪进去，工兵铲横在胸前，先扫了一圈。

    这是一间老式的二居室套房，面积不大，客厅连着餐厅，左右各开了一间卧室的门。

    靠墙的位置摆着一张矮桌，桌腿已经断了一根，整张桌子歪斜着靠在墙上。

    墙角堆着几个纸箱，箱体早就烂透了，里面的东西散落一地。

    几件腐朽得看不出颜色的衣服，一双塑料拖鞋，几个碎了的陶瓷杯子。

    这里很显然有人住过。

    而且从家具和杂物的风格来看，住的应该是普通人家，生活条件不算好。

    陈峰走进客厅，环顾四周。

    他先检查了两间卧室。

    左边的已经被塌下来的天花板填满了进不去，右边那间倒还算完整，一张铁架床歪在墙边，还有一只翻转的床头柜。

    陈峰用铲背把床头柜翻过来，随后用力拽了两下，直接把腐朽的抽屉扯了出来。

    里面是一支锈得看不出颜色的笔，几枚灰黑色的硬币，还有一个本子。

    “嗯？”

    陈峰微微挑眉，蹲下来，把本子捡起来。

    本子的封面是硬纸壳材质，边角卷曲发霉，颜色早已辨不出原来是什么。

    但装订还算结实，翻开之后，内页虽然泛黄发脆，字迹倒是还算完好。

    陈峰从个人空间中摸出一支小型手电筒，照在这本笔记本上。

    在高灵气环境下，电信号会被屏蔽，电子设备也极易因为灵气的侵蚀而失灵。

    不过手电筒这种东西，还是能撑一段时间的。

    灯光照亮了书页上的文字。

    字体很小，一笔一划写得工整，用的是一种他从未见过的文字。

    有点像是简体字，很多偏旁部首几乎一模一样，只是笔画的连接方式和某些部件有细微的差异。

    似乎是从繁体字演变出来的另一套简化方案。

    陈峰多看了几行，渐渐摸出了规律。

    大部分字他都能猜出意思，少数几个实在看不懂的，结合上下文也能推断个八九不离十。

    这是一本日记。

    第一页的日期写着“东元278年，八月十二日”。

    陈峰翻了翻，日期的跨度不大，前后大概三四个月的时间。

    他把本子翻回第一页，就着手电筒的灯光，一行一行地读了下去。

    “今天又被孙老头骂了一顿。”

    “数学考了四十七分，他让我站在讲台边上站了一整节课，腿都站麻了，旁边的女生一直偷笑，好烦。”

    “不过放学的时候，许小莹问我借红笔，她主动跟我说话了！”

    “我把笔给她的时候不小心碰到她的手了，她应该没注意到吧？应该没有吧？”

    陈峰嘴角抽了抽。

    这日记的主人，应该是个中学生。

    他继续往下翻。

    “八月十九日。许小莹今天扎了高马尾，特别好看。我盯着看了好久，被同桌发现了，他说要告诉全班。”

    “我威胁他，他要是敢说出去，我就把他上次在课堂偷看黄色漫画的事告诉班主任，他怂了。”

    “八月二十七日。期中考试完了，成绩还没出来，估计又要挨骂。不过管他呢，反正我又不想考大学，我爸说了，以后跟他学修车也能养活自己。”

    “九月一日。成绩出来了，语文六十一，数学五十二，自然科学三十八。孙老头这次没骂我，但是叹了一口气，他叹气比骂我还难受。”

    陈峰翻页的速度很快。
content_en:
Chen Feng pushed open the door.

    The rusty hinges made a screeching sound.

    He ducked in sideways, with the engineer's shovel across his chest, and swept around first.

    This is an old-fashioned two-bedroom suite with a small area. The living room is connected to the dining room, with a bedroom door on the left and right.

    There was a low table placed against the wall. One of its legs had been broken, and the entire table was leaning against the wall.

    There were several cardboard boxes piled up in the corner. The boxes were rotten and the contents were scattered all over the floor.

    A few pieces of clothes that were too rotten to see the color, a pair of plastic slippers, and a few broken ceramic cups.

    Someone had obviously lived here.

    And judging from the style of the furniture and sundries, it seems that the people living here are ordinary people, and the living conditions are not good.

    Chen Feng walked into the living room and looked around.

    He checked the two bedrooms first.

    The one on the left has been filled with the collapsed ceiling and cannot be entered, but the one on the right is still intact, with an iron frame bed leaning against the wall and an overturned bedside table.

    Chen Feng used the back of a shovel to turn over the bedside table, then pulled hard twice and pulled out the rotten drawer.

    Inside was a pen that was too rusty to see the color, a few gray-black coins, and a notebook.

    "Huh?"

    Chen Feng raised his eyebrows slightly, squatted down, and picked up the notebook.

    The cover of the book is made of cardboard, the corners are curled and moldy, and the color is no longer distinguishable from its original cover.

    However, the binding is still strong. After opening it, although the inner pages are yellowed and brittle, the handwriting is still intact.

    Chen Feng took out a small flashlight from his personal space and shined it on the notebook.

    In a high aura environment, electrical signals will be shielded, and electronic equipment will easily malfunction due to the erosion of aura.

    But something like a flashlight can still last for a while.

    The light illuminated the words on the page.

    The font was small, written neatly one stroke at a time, using a type of writing he had never seen before.

    It's a bit like simplified Chinese characters. Many radicals are almost identical, but there are slight differences in the way the strokes are connected and some components.

    It seems to be another set of simplification solutions evolved from traditional Chinese characters.

    Chen Feng read a few more lines and gradually figured out the pattern.

    He could guess the meaning of most of the words, and for the few that he really couldn't understand, he could roughly deduce the meaning based on the context.

    This is a diary.

    The date on the first page reads "August 12, AD 278."

    Chen Feng flipped through it and found that the date span was not large, about three or four months.

    He turned the book back to the first page and read line by line using the light of the flashlight.

    "I was scolded by Old Man Sun again today."

    "I scored 47 points in the math test. He made me stand on the edge of the podium for the whole class. My legs were numb from standing. The girl next to me kept snickering. It was so annoying."

    "But when school was over, Xu Xiaoying asked me to borrow a red pen, and she took the initiative to talk to me!"

    "When I gave the pen to her, I accidentally touched her hand. She probably didn't notice, right? Maybe not?"

    Chen Feng's mouth twitched.

    The owner of this diary should be a middle school student.

    He continued to scroll down.

    "August 19th. Xu Xiaoying wore a high ponytail today, which looks very beautiful. I stared at it for a long time, and my deskmate noticed it. He said he would tell the whole class."

    "I threatened him. If he dared to tell me, I would tell the class teacher about the pornographic comics he secretly read in class last time. He gave up."

    "August 27th. The midterm exam is over and the results haven't come out yet. I'm probably going to get scolded again. But whatever, I don't want to go to college anyway. My dad said that I can support myself by learning how to repair cars with him in the future."

    "September 1st. The results are out. Chinese language is 61, mathematics is 52, and natural science is 38. Old man Sun didn't scold me this time, but he sighed. His sigh was more uncomfortable than scolding me."

    Chen Feng turned the pages very quickly.
